Your keys, your stocks

  • COUR never holds your assets. Every send and swap is signed by your wallet.
  • Stock tokens are issued by licensed partners and track the real share price.
  • Tokens trade 24/7; the underlying price updates during market hours.

Liquidity pools

Every token on COUR trades against a real stock. Once a token graduates, its liquidity is seeded by COUR and permanently burned. LP fee is 0% — there are no LP rewards. Providing your own liquidity is coming soon.
